title: docs(adr): ADR-0156 a compiled metadata answer is cached only when every source counts its own changes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7M2UeBw2UaWzE4U5gbL4AH)_

Part of #34206 (the second of three changes: the cascade-delete memo #34437, merged as `d18d54bd`; then this record; then the shared compile cache, per ruling 6920925378, which ordered this record first as its own pull request). The card stays open after this lands.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 ADR-0156,写下「编译好的元数据结果什么时候可以缓存」的规则:它读的每个来源都要在自己改动的地方记一个变更计数,再加一个时间上限兜住本进程看不到的改动;只缓存所有人共用的部分,权限门、字段遮罩、翻译和 ETag 每次请求照算。另把 `meta-overlay-cache.ts` 里那段「只缓存行集」的说明改成只约束它自己这一层,并指向本记录。
- 为什么改:这是你 6920925378 裁决 B 要求的先行记录,第三步共享编译缓存要照它来建;旧注释读起来像「任何地方都不许缓存合并结果」,不改会和第三步打架。
- 风险与回滚:只有文档和一段注释,不改任何运行代码,不发布。回滚就是撤掉这一个 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0156-compiled-metadata-answer-cache-every-source-counts-its-own-changes.md` 的 D1 到 D3(规则、计数归来源自己、只缓存共用部分),再看 D5(过期后先便宜确认,不重编译)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:adr-index && pnpm check:adr-anchors && node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`,预期全部 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:这是 Tier H 记录,需要你批准这个 PR;批准后席位落地,再开第三步。

## What changes

- **New record**, `docs/adr/0156-compiled-metadata-answer-cache-every-source-counts-its-own-changes.md`, status Accepted on ruling 6920925378. It declares and implements nothing:
  - D1: a compiled metadata answer (derived from more than one source) is cached only when every source it reads exposes a change counter that moves on every change, and a time bound covers changes this process cannot observe. Both, always (ADR-0127 applied per source).
  - D2: each source owns its counter at its own mutation point, never a cache-side list of call sites; a source without a counter makes the cache decline; counters are in-process and never go on the wire (`content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` §6.1 stands).
  - D3: only the caller-independent part is cached; the per-caller gate, field mask, translation and `ETag` run on every request. No per-caller whole-answer cache without a new ruling.
  - D4: a hit leaves the SchemaRegistry populated exactly as a miss does (`getMetaItems` hydration).
  - D5: on expiry, confirm cheaply (in-process counters plus one store reading) before recompiling.
  - D6: one `OS_*` knob, `0` is the uncached path with the same reads in the same order.
  - D7: the pins the implementing change carries; D8: what happens to the overlay cache's own text.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/meta-overlay-cache.ts`**, comment only: the section heading now reads "Why THIS cache holds only the row set, and never the merged answer", and one paragraph says the position is about this module and that a merged-answer cache elsewhere is governed by ADR-0156. The warning against moving this cache below the merge stays.
- **`docs/adr/README.md`**, regenerated by `pnpm adr:index` (the new row; Accepted count 134).

## Tests

None owed: no runtime line changes. The record's D7 lists the pins the third change must carry.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance was rewritten by the same ruling: the "`meta` under 20 ms" line is withdrawn, and each change reports before and after `meta` for an immediate repeat, a 304 and a reload more than one minute later. This record has no readings of its own; the cascade-delete memo's are on #34437.
- `skip-changeset`: an ADR plus a comment-only edit publishes nothing.
